BRISCO COUNTY (Meridian Brief) — An audit of Brisco County's finances found that $2.3 million in road maintenance funds could not be accounted for, according to findings made public March 14, 2024.

County Auditor Dolores Venkataraman presented the results to the county board during its regular public session, where the Brisco County Fiscal Year 2022-23 Performance Audit was released.

The report rests on a review of the county's spending records for that fiscal year. It identifies the missing road maintenance money as the central shortfall.

People familiar with the matter said board members received the findings without prior public discussion of the missing funds.

Those people said the board is expected to consider next steps on how the money was handled. No further details on the shortfall were immediately available.

Meridian Brief will update this item as more information becomes available.
